scope: Isolated local mocks only; no live GAS mutations

results.name: all classic page scripts and Apps Script parse successfully
IDs stay unique after deletion and between clients
legacy cross-team submission ID collision is not dropped
same request retried creates one submission and one set of notifications
comment collisions do not duplicate existing comments from other authors
dual role can submit own team through dedicated and compatible save paths
submission rejects another team, missing text and unassigned targets
restore collision stops every collection without partial changes
nonconflicting restore preserves relationships
ordinary students still receive no internal calendar or work data
all main desktop views render without errors
untrusted names render only as text and unsafe URLs are blocked
remember email never stores a password and removes legacy credentials
failed submission retains text and modal; retry uses same request and confirms once
queued edits and their callers wait for the latest save
uploaded attachment and text are restored from the tab draft
failed publish keeps form and reuses the same draft ID
confirmed earlier submission unlocks a changed draft without dropping its text
blocked browser storage does not turn cloud confirmation into failure
large upload completion keeps a draft and ignores stale account messages
state conflict does not silently discard local changes
time fields preserve focus and Done closes with the selected value
invalid time gets a clear message instead of silently changing it
mobile modal stays within viewport and scrolls to its action buttons
late save does not reopen a logged-out account
stale bootstrap error does not clear a newer login
stalled login times out, releases button and keeps entered values
no uncaught browser runtime errors
